<thought>Based on the observed isotopic pattern (M, M+1 ≈20 %, M+2 ≈2 %, M+3 ≈0.12 %, etc.) the intensities match the binomial distribution expected for ~18 carbon atoms and do not show the characteristic signatures of elements such as Cl, Br, S, Si, etc. Therefore, carbon is the only element that can be definitively identified from the spectrum.</thought>
<final_answer>['C']</final_answer>
